seo.title: Customer quote
seo.seo_description: Customer quote: a WorkStudio starter template for small business. Starting fields, steps, human approval and what is left to validate with your adviser.

blocks.role: Promesse de la fiche : ce que fait le gabarit « Devis client », dit sans détour.

translation.headline: Customer quote.
translation.subheadline: The Customer quote template drafts a structured quote from the customer and their services, unit prices before tax: a table, the subtotal, GST at 5%, QST at 9.975% calculated on the subtotal, the total in Canadian dollars, the validity period and the payment terms.

blocks.role: Réponse d'abord : ce que fait le gabarit, en trois lignes.

translation.title: The short answer.
translation.body:
The Customer quote template drafts a structured quote from the customer and their services, unit prices before tax: a table, the subtotal, GST at 5%, QST at 9.975% calculated on the subtotal, the total in Canadian dollars, the validity period and the payment terms. A person reads the text before sending it.

A workflow template is an automated sequence of tasks, provided as a starting point in WorkStudio and to be adapted to the business before it is deployed.

blocks.role: Les champs de départ du gabarit, tels que déclarés dans WorkStudio.

translation.title: What you provide.
translation.body:
Each starting field is pre-filled with an example value so a first run needs no typing, except email addresses and files.

  • The customer. Customer name and contact details.
  • The services. Services, quantities and unit prices before tax.

blocks.role: Les étapes du flux : ce que fait chaque agent, où une personne intervient.

cards.title: Draft the quote.
cards.text: An agent presents a table (item, quantity, unit price, total before tax), then the subtotal, GST at 5% and QST at 9.975%, each calculated on the subtotal, never on the GST, and rounded to the cent. It adds the total with taxes, a validity period of thirty days, payment net thirty days and, in the header, the GST, QST and NEQ numbers to fill in.

cards.title: Review.
cards.text: You read the text produced, correct it if needed, then use or send it yourself: the template sends nothing.

blocks.role: Ce qui s'adapte avant l'usage : le propre du gabarit, le commun, l'envoi.

cards.title: What to adapt here.
cards.text: The GST and QST registration numbers and the Quebec enterprise number (NEQ) stay in square brackets, to fill in. A service exempt from tax, or a business that is not registered, is flagged in brackets rather than guessed. Only the federal GST and the QST are covered: other provinces' taxes, such as the harmonized sales tax, are not.

cards.title: What applies to all.
cards.text: The templates are written for a Quebec small business: amounts in Canadian dollars, GST and QST wherever a tax applies, and Quebec business vocabulary. They do not guarantee any tax or legal compliance: the examples are fictional, and your accountant or adviser validates the result before use.

cards.title: Nothing is sent.
cards.text: The template produces text to review. Only five templates in the collection send an email, and each waits first for a person's approval.

blocks.role: Questions de la fiche : envoi, point propre au gabarit, adaptation au Québec.

items.question: Does this template send anything for me?
items.answer: No. It produces text to review; you use or send it yourself. Only five templates in the collection send an email, and each waits first for a person's approval.

items.question: Does the template compute GST and QST?
items.answer: Yes, through its instructions: GST at 5% and QST at 9.975%, each on the subtotal before tax and rounded to the cent. An agent does the calculation from the text; it is not accounting software, so review the amounts before sending the quote.

items.question: Does it suit my business?
items.answer: It starts from a quote by a Quebec business, with fictional examples. Your tax registration status, exempt services and terms are not guessed: your accountant or adviser validates the quote before it goes out.

blocks.role: Appel à l'action : démonstration sur données fictives.

translation.title: See it at work.
translation.text: A demonstration on fictional data, to see what the template prepares and where a person stays in control.
